d:
Tapu Sena plays cricket in the Gokuldham society compound during their vacations. Annoyed by their loud shouting while trying to rest, Bhide threatens them with "pin-drop silence." When they purposely resume appealing loudly, Bhide dumps a bucket of water from his balcony to teach them a lesson—accidentally soaking Dr. Hathi, who had just stepped in to talk to the kids.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
